title: Ebb Flow quota controller and rollback safety playbook
creator: Lena Park
description: Goal: Design and ship a conservative, chaos-tolerant quota controller (Ebb Flow) that absorbs short bursts with local grace leases, preserves inter-tenant fairness, and provides safe rollback semantics for limiter outages. This ticket covers design decisions, a simulation harness, implementation plan, dashboards, and an operational playbook for incidents and gradual rollout. The primary motivation is to reduce customer-facing errors during partial limiter outages and region failovers while keeping tail latency within SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator reproduces historical burst patterns and shows reduced 5xx rate under Ebb Flow compared to current baseline
Per-tenant fairness metric (90th/50th token-utilization ratio) improves or remains within 10% of baseline after rollout
Grace lease mechanism limits sustained overuse to configured window and automatically drains without manual intervention
Rollback path (circuit-open to passthrough to fallback region) can be executed via Console with <5 min RTO and clear audit trail
Grafana dashboards (burst-detection, lease-health, fairness-heatmap) merged and visible to SRE and PM teams
progress_notes: 2026-02-12 - Created: initial problem statement and goals. Baseline analysis shows 0.6% 5xx spike during region ingress bursts (prod namespace: customer-facing).

2026-02-20 - Design review: proposed components: local grace lease (30s default), predictive bloom detector for burst start/stop, hierarchical fallback policy (tenant -> region -> global), and rollback circuit with timed drain. Feedback: reduce lease default to 20s for latency-sensitive routes. (Reviewer: Sofia Ruiz)

2026-02-25 - Prototype: implemented lease token bucket shim in admission proxy (lab cluster). Early tests show 35% reduction in short 5xx spikes in synthetic bursts. Observability: added lease-heartbeat metric and per-tenant breach counter.

2026-03-02 - Simulation: ran 72-hour trace replay using historical ingress patterns (Jan 2026). Compared Ebb Flow to baseline and to naive global-shedder. Ebb Flow kept tail latency within SLO 97% of the time while reducing emergency fallthrough events by 42%.

2026-03-07 - Security and Ops review: confirmed that KMS calls are not added on the hot path; rollback requires Console feature flag + runbook. Ops asks for guaranteed audit log entries for any automatic fallback.
2026-03-10 - Implementation: PR opened for admission proxy changes and shared config. Preparing canary rollout plan targeting non-critical regions first.
rollback_plan: Console feature flag to open circuit -> route to fallback region -> monitor lease drain -> revert feature flag. Expected RTO: 5 minutes.
notes_from_review: Sofia: prefer shorter default lease for low-latency routes; add per-route lease tuning in config
Tomás: add deterministic test for lease expiry races; unit tests for race between lease drain and fallback trigger
Evan: ensure telemetry exports include token-level traces for top 10 tenants to diagnose fairness regressions
